title: Publish the results on the marketing site only where a recording supports them
description: When T3 to T6 have recordings: update the opening story's end beat with the new cycle count and accuracy; add the fifth beat to the rule pictogram only if the least-confident slice holds most of the mistakes in the recording; update the calibration curve, the two-numbers panel, and the how-it-works detail from the new fixture; keep every number read from the fixture and pinned by tests. The site must never claim an outcome a recording does not show.
